variants.label: Dashboard
variants.tooltip: Exposes layout capabilities to end users in a Perspective Session. Widgets are configured in the Designer by designers and made available to Perspective Session users.

pack.description: Enables widget packing algorithm. When disabled, widgets can be placed anywhere on the Dashboard and the component will not try to rearrange them in an optimal layout.

isEditing.description: Whether the dashboard is in runtime edit mode.

editingToggle.description: Whether to display the dashboard editing toggle.

fixed.description: Fixed configuration used when dashboard mode is fixed.

rowCount.description: The number of rows in the grid

columnCount.description: The number of columns in the grid

rowGutterSize.description: The size of the grid gaps or gutters between rows in pixels.

columnGutterSize.description: The size of the grid gaps or gutters between columns in pixels.

stretch.description: Stretch configuration used when dashboard mode is stretch.

rowCount.description: The number of rows in the grid

columnCount.description: The number of columns in the grid

rowGutterSize.description: The size of the grid gaps or gutters between rows in pixels.

columnGutterSize.description: The size of the grid gaps or gutters between columns in pixels.

viewPath.description: The current configured view path of the widget.

viewParams.description: Parameters for the view. If passing parameters into the embedded view, the names here must match the parameters on that view.

isConfigurable.description: If enabled, provides a toggle that becomes available when a widget is selected which is used to configure the widgets view. When the toggled on, the configuring view parameter will be true.

enabled.description: Whether the widget header should show.

minSize.description: This widgets minimum size used when determining widget layout.

columnSpan.description: The minimum allowable columns that this widget may span.

rowSpan.description: The minimum allowable rows that this widget may span.

position.description: The widgets position in the dashboard.

viewPath.description: The primary view path of the widget.

viewParams.descriptions: Parameters for the view. If passing parameters into the embedded view, the names here must match the parameters on that view.

isConfigurable.description: If enabled, provides a toggle that becomes available when a widget is selected which is used to configure the widgets view. When the toggled on, the configuring view parameter will be true.

minSize.description: This widgets minimum size used when determining widget layout.

columnSpan.description: The minimum allowable columns that this widget may span.

rowSpan.description: The minimum allowable rows that this widget may span.

category.description: A category in which to group this widget when displayed in the add widgets modal.

name.description: A unique name to provide this widget.  This is used in the add widget modal.

enabled.description: Whether the widget header should show.
